npcs.name: Mara Thimble
npcs.voice: warm, brisk, middle-aged woman with a soft coastal accent
barks: Tide's kind today. Don't waste it talking to me.
Butterperch fry up lovely. Not that I'd know. I'm far too busy.
If you see a light out past the Teeth, don't row toward it. Just… don't.
Your rod's older than you are. Treat it gently.

npcs.name: Pell
npcs.voice: very old, slow, gentle man; deep, dry, a little amused
barks: High water at a quarter past never. Low water just after you've forgotten.
The lamp remembers. That's the trouble with lamps.
Mind the second moon. It minds you.

npcs.name: Wick
npcs.voice: excited young child, quick and breathless
barks: I'm drawing a fish with nine eyes. No, ten. It keeps changing.
Biscuit ate my blue crayon. Now everything's a bit green.
Did you know fish dream? I asked one. It said yes.
